fieldValues.title: X2: terminology normalisation and glossary pass
fieldValues.summary: Replaces retired terms with current ones across the rendered spec (SCDS, Typed Record/TypedRecord, TagDefinition, Tier 3, Document View), fixes three dangling §N references, deletes two superseded design notes stranded next to their replacements, and reduces four retired-mechanism sections to one dormancy leaf each citing the record that retired it.
fieldValues.body:
Cross-cutting unit from the readability wave read-through (docs/programme/read-through-2026-09-17.md §4, unit X2). No dependency; ran first per the suggested order (X2, X1, X3, then Parts in order).

Replaced retired terms with current ones wherever they still appeared in prose: SCDS (9 sites), Typed Record/TypedRecord (9), TagDefinition (2), Tier 3 (1), Document View (10, superseded by Composition per rfc-decision-92d2da05). Fixed the three dangling §N references. Deleted the two superseded design notes found stranded next to their replacement and the retired-mechanism sections (ext:changelog, ext:federation, ext:recommended-relations, the pre-RFC-032 valueType map), leaving one dormancy leaf per mechanism citing the record that retired it.

Executes rfc-decision-92d2da05, rfc-decision-53635966, rfc-decision-2a1e1590, and the federation disposition (rfc-decision-4f1e12e5 lineage).

PR: https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/pull/817 (merged).
